issue: EC oxidation anchor may not belong to the same Ue series as the other 13 rows
finding: Ue 1994 selects solvents by a melting-point criterion (mp < 30 C). EC melts at 36.4 C, so it cannot be in the 20-solvent table of the primary source (whose reagent section lists only battery-grade PC, BC and GBL). The EC = 6.5 V entry in Okoshi 2015 Fig. 1 therefore most likely comes from the second Ue reference.
evidence_type: literature criterion (melting-point selection rule) - independent of the ordering result; NOT a result-driven exclusion
